visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a light pink turtleneck sweater, sits in a professional office environment. She speaks with high energy, holding a black lapel microphone. Behind her are bookshelves, certificates, and a window. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up 2D and 3D animation sequence illustrating skin layers. Red patches and dark brown spots are shown on a skin-texture surface, followed by a microscopic view of cells as pink and purple blocks with black spiky pigment particles between them. (3) Returning to the presenter, she gestures emphatically with her hands. Stylized red and white text overlays with star graphics appear around her. She looks directly into the lens with an engaging expression. (4) A technical animation displays white rays of light hitting the cell structure, accompanied by floating mathematical equations and chemical formulas over a light blue background. (5) The presenter reappears, pointing her finger and holding a yellow fabric sample to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (6) The video concludes with a clean white screen featuring the brand logo and name in black with elegant curved line graphics.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking in a clear, energetic tone with a professional Mandarin accent. An upbeat electronic pop background music track starts simultaneously with a strong rhythmic beat. A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect plays as the initial text logo appears. (2) As the speaker transitions into technical explanations, a series of light 'bubble' and 'pop' sound effects punctuate the dialogue, corresponding to visual changes in the cellular animation. The background music remains steady in tempo. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during a quick scene cut. The speaker's pitch rises during key emphasis moments. Short, digital 'notification' style sound effects play when variety-show text graphics flash on screen. (4) The speaker adopts a more authoritative warning tone; the vocal intensity increases slightly while the music maintains its high energy. A rhythmic 'stinger' accentuates the repeated 'absolute impossibility' phrase. (5) The audio concludes with a final energetic sentence from the speaker, followed by a short musical resolution jingle and a fade to studio silence as the brand logo is displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Myth Busting -> Scientific Explanation -> Conclusion & CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the limitations of using topical Vitamin A (A-acid) for different types of skin pigmentation. It distinguishes between easily treated acne scars and complex melasma (liver spots), providing biological reasons for why professional medical advice is necessary for the latter. The ultimate goal is to promote the creator's skincare brand and professional expertise.
